title: Circle of Inner Binding
wikitext:
[[Image:Circle of Inner Binding.jpg|thumb|Circle of Inner Binding]]
One of the [[Circles of Binding]] in [[Arathi Highlands]]. It lies in the southern part of the region, near [[Stromgarde]], and is guarded by [[earth elemental]]s.

It is through this Circle's shard that [[Myzrael]] was able to contact mortal travelers.
